overview_description.description: Cloudbeds is the hospitality management system built for ambitious hoteliers who demand more. The Cloudbeds platform unifies operations, distribution, guest experience, and revenue marketing, giving operators a breadth of tools to capture demand, grow direct bookings, optimize pricing, maximize upsell revenue, and act on real-time intelligence within a single system. Designed to scale with independent hotels, large hotel groups, and multi-property portfolios, Cloudbeds is trusted by tens of thousands of properties in more than 150 countries.  Founded in 2012, Cloudbeds is recognized as a top Hotel Management System, PMS, and Channel Manager — and Best Place to Work — by Hotel Tech Report for eight consecutive years.

product.name: Property Management System (PMS)
product.description: A cloud-based system for managing hotel operations including reservations, room inventory, rate management, and multi-property functionality.

product.name: Channel Manager
product.description: Software that synchronizes room availability, rates, and inventory across over 300 online travel agencies and booking channels in real time.

product.name: Booking Engine
product.description: An integrated, commission-free online booking system that enables direct reservations through a property's website with multi-language and currency support.

product.name: Cloudbeds Payments
product.description: A payment processing solution tailored for hospitality that automates transactions and supports various payment methods including mobile wallets and contactless payments.

product.name: Whistle for Cloudbeds
product.description: A guest communication platform that centralizes messaging, automates interactions, and supports guest engagement and back-of-house operations.

product.name: Cloudbeds Insights
product.description: A unified data and reporting tool that consolidates property data to generate customizable reports and analytics for decision-making.
